notes.status: UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. tools/deploy-pontes/deploy_pontes.py does NOT read this file: its stable-bridge schema has an `ethereum` section and its run / verify steps read an Ethereum vault through --source-rpc (code hash, routeId, cap, an unused vault). The Solana equivalent of those checks is not built; see docs/SOLANA-BRIDGE-DEPLOY-CEREMONY.md section 7
notes.token: BridgedStablecoinV3, byte-identical to the Ethereum bridge's token (creation code keccak256 0xe560441f37e247e387cebd23bb3dd798a29d34174a9fb19a4bb3877c6c721de7); only the constructor arguments differ
notes.source: sourceChainId is keccak256("BLOCH-SVM-CHAIN-ID-v1" || genesis hash bytes) as a uint256; sourceVault is the vault's 20-byte identity vault20 = last 20 bytes of keccak256("BLOCH-SVM-VAULT-ID-v1" || program id || vault address); sourceRoute is the vault's route. Both come from `sol_vault.py verify` after the vault is initialized
notes.limits: the same as bUSDC: supply cap 100,000 USDC, bucket 10,000 USDC refilled in 24 h, T = 0 (every mint waits largeMintDelay 12 h and stays cancellable by 2 of 3 guardians), minBurn 10 USDC
notes.keys: signers: the seven l2-mint-signer keys; guardians: the three l2-token-guardian keys (docs/BRIDGE-V3-KEY-CEREMONY.md). The same keys as bUSDC: the token's EIP-712 domain contains the token address and the L2 chain id, so a mint certificate of one token is not valid on another
notes.burn: a holder burns to the 20-byte commitment of a Solana wallet (SolanaRecipientRegistry.commitmentOf) and announces the wallet once on the registry
notes.TBD-owner: source.revision; deployer.address; deployer.fundedBy.safe; signers.set; guardians.set; tx.maxGasPriceWei; solana.vaultAddress, solana.programId, solana.vault20, solana.route (TBD-deploy, from the vault's verify output); registry.address (TBD-deploy)
